title: com.reply arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Exactly one of two forms: a participant answers a message (idempotency and replyTo), a responder answers the request it holds (fence). A call carrying both, or neither, is refused. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

replyTo.description: The message answered, in a thread the caller's Project takes part in; the reply joins that thread.

fence.description: The responder's fence; the reply answers fence.request in its thread. A reply is not a completion: the request's state does not change.
